text: Which statement about pure (simple) tensors v ⊗ w in V ⊗ W is correct?
choices: They span V ⊗ W, but not every element of V ⊗ W is pure
Every element of V ⊗ W is a pure tensor
They form a subspace of V ⊗ W
A sum of two pure tensors is always pure
explanation: General elements are finite sums of pure tensors; e₁ ⊗ f₁ + e₂ ⊗ f₂ cannot be rewritten as a single v ⊗ w (its coefficient matrix has rank 2, while pure tensors give rank 1). The pure tensors form a cone, not a subspace.
